stories.title: Israeli Judges Recommend Dropping Charges Against Netanyahu in Corruption Trial
stories.summary: Judges in Israel have recommended dropping one of the most serious charges in the corruption trial against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces accusations of bribery, fraud, and breach of trust. This recommendation has been seen as a significant boost for Netanyahu, who has consistently denied any wrongdoing. The trial, which began in 2020, has been a contentious issue in Israeli politics, particularly as Netanyahu seeks to maintain his political position.

stories.title: Dozens Killed in Cairo Highway Fire Following Fuel Tanker Crash
stories.summary: A fuel tanker crash on a major highway surrounding Cairo has resulted in at least 30 fatalities and 15 injuries. The vehicle, carrying petroleum products, reportedly overturned and ignited a massive fire, leading to a significant emergency response. Authorities have indicated that the death toll may rise as investigations continue.

stories.title: North Korea Orders Closure of Swiss Diplomatic Office and Expels Envoy
stories.summary: North Korea has expelled a Swiss diplomat and demanded the closure of Switzerland's newly opened diplomatic office in Pyongyang. This action follows Switzerland's recent sanctions against a camp accused of indoctrinating Ukrainian children, which North Korea condemned. The Swiss office was inaugurated on October 19 during a visit by Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis.

stories.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia Arrives in Spain After Leaving the U.S.
stories.summary: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, an El Salvador native who was mistakenly deported by ICE last year, has left the United States and arrived in Spain. His departure marks the conclusion of a 20-month legal battle related to his deportation, which became emblematic of the Trump administration's immigration policies. Garcia traveled to Spain with his wife, stating he feels like a 'free man' after the ordeal.

stories.title: Six People Die in Plane Crash Off Mississippi Coast
stories.summary: A small plane crashed off the coast of Mississippi, resulting in the deaths of all six passengers, including two children aged 10 and 12. The plane was traveling from New Orleans to Fort Myers, Florida, when it lost contact with air traffic control. The Coast Guard has recovered the bodies, and an investigation into the cause of the crash is underway.

stories.title: Record Number of Migrants Arrive in Canary Islands in One Day
stories.summary: Nearly 2,000 migrants arrived in the Canary Islands in a single day, marking a record for the archipelago. The maritime rescue service reported that 1,990 individuals reached the islands aboard 15 boats, with many departing from Senegal and Gambia. This surge in arrivals coincides with Spain's upcoming elections, prompting concerns about unprecedented migration pressure on the region.

This decision follows a series of negative comments made by Rodgers about the coaching staff.

stories.title: Russian Strikes Kill Seven in Ukraine; Kyiv Targets Refineries
stories.summary: Russian drone attacks resulted in the deaths of seven people across six Ukrainian regions, targeting infrastructure including a gas production facility and a thermal power plant. In response, Ukraine launched drone strikes on Russian oil refineries in the Samara and Rostov regions, as well as an airbase in Nizhny Novgorod, leading to at least one reported death in the Samara region.

This figure, which includes death certificates registered until the end of August, highlights the significant toll of the conflict. The Kremlin has declined to comment on these reports, stating that only the defense ministry can provide official casualty figures.
